prompt_text: I need my roof replaced in Dallas. Which specific roofing companies should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
I can give you specific Dallas roofers — but to make the recommendations useful I need your neighborhood or ZIP code and a few details (roof type, approximate size/age, are you filing an insurance claim, and your timeline). Do you want only highly rated local contractors, national firms with Dallas crews, or a mix?

While you reply, here are immediate, practical steps and what I’ll use to pick the best companies for you:

What I need from you
- ZIP code / neighborhood in Dallas
- Roof type (asphalt shingle, tile, metal, flat/TPO/modified)
- Is this a storm/insurance claim or out-of-pocket replacement?
- Desired timeline (ASAP, within 1–3 months, flexible)
- Any budget or warranty preferences

How I’ll choose which companies to recommend
- Manufacturer certifications (GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster, etc.)
- Local experience with Dallas climate and storm claims
- Positive recent customer reviews (Google/Yelp)
- BBB rating and any complaint history
- Proper insurance (liability + workers’ comp) and local licensing/registration
- Warranty offerings (manufacturer + workmanship)
- Willingness to provide written detailed estimates & references

If you want to call companies right away — what to ask (quick call script)
- Are you licensed and insured? Can you email proof of insurance now?
- Are you a [manufacturer] certified installer? Which warranties do you offer?
- Do you handle permits and HOA requirements?
- Do you provide a written estimate with tear-off, disposal, and ventilation details?
- Can you provide 3 recent Dallas references and a project timeline?
- Who will manage my insurance claim (if applicable)?

Red flags (stop and verify)
- Door-to-door storm-chaser pressure tactics; insist on written bids and time to compare
- Demands for large upfront cash payments or “we can only start if you pay full now”
- No physical address or unverifiable references
- No written warranty or vague estimate

Next steps
- Tell me your ZIP and the details listed above and I’ll return a short list (3–6) of specific Dallas contractors to call with reasons why each one is a good fit and which jobs they’re best for (insurance claims, budget replacements, premium warranties, etc.).
- If you already have 1–2 estimates, send me the key details and I’ll compare them and point out potential issues.

Tell me your ZIP and a couple of those details and I’ll make a tailored list.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
